profiles.name: CRANK
profiles.tagline: SHORT GAME IN A KNIFE FIGHT
profiles.profile: This is a guy who can absolutely scrape a round out of the swamp when the driver is busy setting fire to the first act. The tee ball has been a recurring tax audit, but the wedges and around-the-green work keep dragging the corpse back to life, and the putter has been just good enough to not fully rat him out. The profile is volatile as hell: one outing he’s salvaging, the next he’s face-planting into a bunker of his own making. Still, when the scoring gets ugly, CRANK usually has the hands to outlast the chaos.

profiles.name: MattF
profiles.profile: When MattF is on, the whole bag turns into a controlled demolition site. The ball goes miles, the approaches show up sharp, and the putter keeps cashing checks like it owns stock in the cup. That’s the clean identity here: aggressive, high-ceiling golf with enough short-game support to make the wrecking ball look polished. The only real complaint is that the scoring can get a little loud and messy around the edges, but this dude has been living in the “make birdies first, ask questions later” lane.

profiles.name: tnboles77
profiles.profile: This file is basically a short-game rescue mission with a driver that occasionally forgets its job. The irons and tee ball have been mixed, but the scrambling has kept the whole thing from turning into a full-blown hostage situation, and the putter has been decent enough to let the saves matter. There’s enough volatility here to make everybody nervous, but there’s also a clear pattern: when tnboles77 isn’t smashing the ball around, he’s still got enough touch to steal a round and make the rest of the field look stupid for a minute.

profiles.name: KeithK75
profiles.tagline: BALLSTRIKING WITH A SIDE OF MAYHEM
profiles.profile: KeithK75 is the definition of a dude who can obliterate a course and still somehow leave room for drama. The ball-striking is the headline, obviously, but the weird part is how often the short game and putting show up like they got invited to the same party. This isn’t some one-note bomber file either; it’s a very real all-around menace when everything clicks, which is often enough to make the rest of the league miserable. The only joke is that even the best version still leaves a little smoke on the furniture.

profiles.name: Dan94
profiles.profile: Dan94 swings like the fairway personally insulted him and the ball is getting what it deserves. The tee game brings the violence, and the irons usually keep the whole operation moving, but there’s just enough putting wobble and occasional chaos to keep things from feeling antiseptic. This is a high-octane profile: plenty of birdie looks, plenty of torque, and enough self-inflicted turbulence to remind you golf is a dumb sport. When it’s humming, he’s a problem; when it isn’t, the scoring gets ugly fast.

profiles.name: BigTime
profiles.profile: BigTime’s file is a weird little crime scene: the irons keep showing up with a hammer, but the putter keeps leaving the room early. The tee ball is a little noisy, the short game has been useful, and the overall shape says this guy can absolutely create chances. But the greenside finish is where the leaks start barking, especially when the three-putt monster gets hungry. If the flat stick ever stops actively trying to mug the rest of the bag, this thing gets real annoying real fast.
